scope: frontend PharmaPOS — 5 read-only agents, 20 checks (1-4 design, 5-8 mobile, 9-12 states, 13-16 real user, 17-20 launch)
notes: Duplicates found by more than one agent are merged into a single issue (see merged_from).

U1 (bill discount carries over to the next bill) also exists in the committed code = live on production now. U2 (parked-bill note carries over) only exists in the uncommitted WIP in pos-workspace.tsx.

pos-workspace.tsx, parked-bills-console.tsx, logout-button.tsx and api/backend/[...path]/route.ts contain someone else's uncommitted WIP. Fixing those files means committing my changes only, not the WIP mixed in.
The User agent created test bills in the local DB (MES-BL2026100800001-0011) — local only, production untouched.
The Mobile agent left the gitignored frontend/.next-dev-alt folder behind and can delete it.

passed_checks: 8: every dialog/sheet/popover fits 320x568 with the close button visible — no issues

issues.title: Bill discount carries over to the next customer's bill after 'เริ่มรายการใหม่'
issues.evidence: Set bill discount 2 → paid → เริ่มรายการใหม่: the field still reads 2; the next bills 0002, 0003, 0007-0011 were all discounted 2 baht (DB bill_discount_amount=2.00). The cashier gets no warning
issues.fix: Add a resetBill() helper that clears billDiscount, parkNote, customer and tendered; call it from startNewSale, checkout success and clearCurrentCart

issues.title: A resumed parked bill's note is written onto every later bill (WIP)
issues.evidence: Bill 0011 (an unrelated product) got notes='QA park phone' from the earlier parked bill
issues.fix: Clear parkNote in resetBill(); send document_note only for bills resumed from a parked bill
issues.outcome_note: fixed in the working tree only — this bug lives in the uncommitted WIP code, so it goes in when the WIP is committed

issues.title: No loading.tsx/Suspense at all — navigating freezes on the old page with no indicator
issues.evidence: find src/app -name loading.tsx = 0; every page awaits Promise.all before rendering
issues.fix: Add (app)/loading.tsx + print/loading.tsx using LoadingState; keep force-dynamic
issues.outcome_note: switched approach: a thin top progress bar shows while navigating between pages (RefreshIndicator), instead of (app)/loading.tsx — a loading.tsx swaps the whole page for a fallback on every search-param change, and testing showed it aborted the dashboard filter navigations (URL never updated). print/loading.tsx is kept

issues.title: Save/delete buttons have no pending/disabled state — double clicks create duplicate records or move stock twice
issues.evidence: e.g. ออกสินค้าทดแทน → POST /product-returns (moves stock) with no busy flag
issues.fix: Add a loading prop to Button + a shared useAsyncAction hook, used by every console

issues.title: No error.tsx/global-error/not-found in (app) — a failed fetch shows Next's default 500 page with no retry and no menu
issues.evidence: /purchase-orders returned 500 (fetch ETIMEDOUT) → 'Application error' page, no way back
issues.fix: Add (app)/error.tsx (Thai message + retry button, inside AppShell), (app)/not-found.tsx, global-error.tsx, print/error.tsx + print/not-found.tsx

issues.title: src/app/page.tsx calls redirect() inside try/catch → logged-in users who open / are sent to /login (including the 404 page's 'กลับหน้าหลัก' button)
issues.fix: Resolve the session inside try, call redirect(home) outside it, rethrow isNextSignal

issues.title: Errors from dialog submits appear behind the modal — the user sees nothing and clicks again
issues.evidence: Duplicate SKU → 409 'SKU หรือบาร์โค้ดนี้มีอยู่แล้ว' shows on the page behind the overlay
issues.fix: Keep a dialogError state and render <Notice tone=error> inside DialogContent

issues.title: requireSession treats a backend outage as a logout → sends the user to /login in a loop
issues.evidence: redirect('/login') on every error, not just 401
issues.fix: Redirect only on ApiError 401/403; rethrow anything else to error.tsx

issues.title: The print page doesn't map a 404 to notFound()
issues.fix: catch ApiError 404 → notFound()

issues.title: catch blocks swallow errors and show them as 'no data'
issues.fix: Keep an error state and show ErrorState/Notice with a retry button instead of setting []
issues.outcome_note: catches that showed errors as 'no data' now show an ErrorState/message; the notification-bell and POS badge polls stay silent on purpose (background, retry every round) — that part is no_change_needed

issues.title: Toast-only load errors — the table is left blank or shows a misleading empty state

issues.title: Dashboard/settings throw away the real error message; settings treats a 500 as an empty list

issues.title: Client fetches have no loading state — the empty state shows while data is still loading

issues.title: router.refresh()/filter changes have no pending indicator (36 places use bare startTransition)

issues.outcome_note: useRefresh() + RefreshIndicator: a progress bar at the top of the screen while router.refresh() / page navigation is running, in all 14 consoles

issues.title: Lists/tables/charts render blank when empty
